message.ja: clone非依存のDesktop，local・Catalogデータを用いたManifest駆動のモデル実行，MNL・NL・RL・CSV変換component，検証済み成果物と作成支援を追加しました．
message.en: Davis adds a clone-independent desktop, manifest-driven model runs with local or catalog data, MNL, NL, RL, and CSV transform components, verified artifacts, and component authoring support.
